remoteSensing.title: Field Intelligence
remoteSensing.eyebrow: Observe from space · verify on the ground
remoteSensing.intro: Allow phone location to see nearby weather and satellite vegetation signals. You do not need to know any coordinates.
remoteSensing.demoNotice: Illustrative public sample polygon in Rajasthan. This is not a real farmer's registered field.
remoteSensing.mapInstructions: Start drawing, then tap each field corner. Finish drawing, or edit and drag corners. You can also enter a boundary below without using the map.
remoteSensing.mapPrivacy: The basemap service receives tile requests when you open the map. Device-centred satellite checks run after location permission when enabled; a field you mark is analyzed when you tap Analyze field.
remoteSensing.areaMismatch: Mapped field area differs from your farm profile. Your farm inputs have not been changed.
remoteSensing.smallField: This field contains fewer than 25 nominal 20 m pixels. Boundary mixing makes spatial interpretation unreliable.
remoteSensing.analysisPrivacy: Allowing location starts nearby satellite checks when enabled. Analyze field sends a marked boundary to Krishyak and Copernicus Data Space. Results are cached to save bandwidth and quota.
remoteSensing.imageExplanation: Acquisition dates are catalog candidates. Loading checks clear pixels on your field. A cloudy date may have no usable image.
remoteSensing.dailyMosaic: Requested day mosaic; exact contributing timestamps are not verified
remoteSensing.imageAlt: Masked satellite image of the selected field
remoteSensing.colorStretch: Natural color uses a display stretch. Transparent areas are excluded pixels.
remoteSensing.legend: Spectral index ramp: brown = lower, green = higher, from −1 to +1. Transparent pixels are excluded. Colors are not disease classes.
remoteSensing.previousField: Previous analyzed field and settings; this summary may differ from the boundary currently shown
remoteSensing.inspect: A change in vegetation may deserve inspection. Satellites cannot determine the cause. Check the field and use crop health, weather, pest and soil tools.
remoteSensing.chartDescription: Clear-observation index over time; gaps indicate insufficient observations
remoteSensing.scientificLimitations: Visible and NIR bands have 10 m pixels; red-edge, SWIR and cloud classification have 20 m pixels. Pixels mix multiple plants and field edges. These indices cannot identify a pest, disease, crop species or exact soil N/P/K.
remoteSensing.qualityExplanation: Only vegetation and bare-soil scene classes are retained. Cloud, shadow, cirrus, snow, water and uncertain pixels are excluded. At least 60% estimated field validity and 10 clear samples are required. Cloud masking is imperfect, and flooded crops may be excluded.
remoteSensing.mosaicExplanation: Each interval is a most-recent-pixel mosaic, not an average of all dates. Exact contributing timestamps are unverified. Trend compares the latest clear interval with four earlier clear intervals; it is an unvalidated inspection cue. Normal crop growth and harvest can also change the signal.
remoteSensing.economicSeparation: Satellite observations do not change Krishyak yield, risk, profit or fertilizer calculations.
remoteSensing.setup: Satellite analysis is unavailable. Ask your administrator to enable remote sensing and configure CDSE credentials. You can still map a field and use the other tools.
remoteSensing.serviceUnavailable: Satellite service is unavailable. Retry later; your other farm tools remain available.
remoteSensing.invalidField: Check your boundary and dates: one valid polygon, 3–200 corners, 100 m²–500 ha, and at most 180 days. Preview uses one acquisition day.
remoteSensing.quota: Satellite processing is busy or the request limit was reached. Retry later.
remoteSensing.timeout: Satellite processing timed out. Retry later.
remoteSensing.offline: Satellite analysis requires internet. You can view your last cached summary below.
remoteSensing.locationFailed: Allow location in your phone browser, then tap Use my location. If location is unavailable, open the map and mark the field corners.
remoteSensing.mapUnavailable: The map or WebGL is unavailable. Use the coordinate editor; numerical results are still accessible.
remoteSensing.imageFailed: Could not display the image. Load it again when connected.
remoteSensing.noImagery: No acquisitions were found for these dates. Try another period.
remoteSensing.storageUnavailable: Device storage is unavailable. This field or summary could not be saved.
remoteSensing.saved: Boundary saved on this device. Delete it here or log out to remove it.
remoteSensing.catalogTruncated: The catalog search reached its page limit. Narrow the date range for a complete list.
remoteSensing.automaticLocation: When you open this page, your phone asks for location permission. Nearby information then loads automatically. For the best view, stand near your farm.
remoteSensing.locationPrivacy: Location is used for nearby weather, place lookup and climate data. Satellite analysis uses a small area around the phone when enabled. Your location is not saved automatically. Map tiles go to the basemap service only when you open the map.
remoteSensing.locationAccuracy: Your phone location is too imprecise for automatic satellite viewing. Weather and climate can still load. Turn on precise location and try again near your farm, or mark the field on the map.
remoteSensing.contextLoading: Loading nearby weather, climate and available reports…
remoteSensing.contextUnavailable: This information is currently unavailable. No estimate has been invented.
remoteSensing.nearbyExplanation: This satellite view covers a 200 m square around your phone. It is nearby context, not your confirmed farm boundary. Roads and neighbouring fields may be included. For your own field, open the map and mark its corners; no coordinates are needed.
remoteSensing.nearbyArea: Nearby view area — not farm size
remoteSensing.autoImageUnavailable: Nearby observations loaded, but an automatic clear image is unavailable. You can choose another image day below.
remoteSensing.weatherModel: Open-Meteo weather model estimate, not a farm sensor measurement
remoteSensing.climateBaseline: 1991–2020 ERA5 model baseline, about 25 km resolution. Temperature is the daily mean over this period; rainfall is the mean yearly total. This is not this season's expected rainfall.
remoteSensing.soilUnavailable: No verified soil map or laboratory record is connected. GPS and satellite colour cannot establish your soil type or exact nutrients.
remoteSensing.pestHistoryUnavailable: An official historical outbreak feed is not connected. Satellite stress cannot identify a pest.
remoteSensing.reportLimitations: Unverified community reports for the region and selected crop, not confirmed pests on your field. Zero reports does not mean pest-free. If district lookup is unavailable, coverage is state-wide.
remoteSensing.planCrop: Crop selected in your farm plan
remoteSensing.cropHistoryUnavailable: Previous crops grown here and satellite crop classification are unavailable. The selected farm-plan crop is not remotely verified.
remoteSensing.diseaseEvidence: Satellite changes can suggest where to inspect. Use a close-up crop photo with the existing crop-health tool for visual assessment; it can be uncertain and is not a field diagnosis.
